_comment: EarnControls' initial governed settings, in whole dollars (scaled by the reserve token's decimals at deploy). offeringCap is the one IV-03 §1.3 offering maximum of $1,000,000 across both products, by price paid: bond Purchase Prices and pool subscriptions together, rolls not counted (decision 38). holderCapFloor is decision 23's 7-day setting: a household may hold at most 10% of the greater of Pool Assets and this floor (decision 40). fundingLimit and poolCapacity are placeholders until the Holdings Board (Funding Limit) and the Lending Board (pool capacity) set them; fundingResolution is then that resolution's hash. Two FUNDING_ROLE holders post Lending Co.'s other indebtedness for borrowed money (decision 39).
_ladderComment: The Ladder (decision 41: terms of 12 to 36 months; 12 months = 365 days, 24 = 730, 36 = 1,095). These are IV-01 Schedule 2's illustration only, not an offer: the Lending Board sets the Ladder, changed afterwards by two LADDER_ROLE signers with 48 hours' notice (decision 31).

networks._comment: Per-network overrides of the settings above, applied by deploy/26_deploy_EarnControls.ts for that network (and its -fork rehearsal). Base Sepolia (owner-approved Nov 16, 2026): test values so subscriptions and purchases can be tried; $100,000 matches the Sepolia Pool Tier; the resolution is keccak256("Holdings Board resolution: Funding Limit and pool capacity (Base Sepolia test placeholder)"). Base mainnet takes none: the Holdings and Lending Boards set those.
